description: Internal works, comprising the removal of existing 3 no. antennas with 3 no. replacement antennas located on existing steelwork, additional back plating to support antennas, removal of 2 no. equipment cabinets and replacement of 1 no. equipment cabinets. Installation of 15 no. Remote Radio Heads fixed to existing steelwork and 1 no. GPS module fixed to stand-off arm.
decision_conditions:
<p>All the antenna and dish faces, and the internal equipment cabinets, shall be painted or
coloured black.
</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the special architectural and historic interest of this building is
safeguarded and that the proposal does not detract from the character and appearance of
the building.</p>

<p>Any equipment or fixtures hereby approved that become redundant or defunct shall be
removed within 6 months of the last date on which they were in use. The installation area
and any damage resulting from their removal shall be repaired and made good on a like
for like basis within 6 months of the last date on which they were in use.
</p><p>REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.</p>

<p>All new works and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or
external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and
to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile unless otherwise
specified in the details hereby approved.
</p><p>REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.</p>

<p>The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.</p><p>REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.</p>

<p>The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.
</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.</p>
site_name: Telecommunication H3g E0035, CHURCH OF THE GOOD SHEPHERD
